subject.title: fix(matrix): deliver reasoning blocks as m.notice when /reasoning on [AI-assisted]

question: After the branch is rebased onto `reasoningPayloadsEnabled`, should this external PR require live Matrix/Element send-read proof before merge, or is the in-memory Matrix adapter proof enough?
rationale: The code path is narrow and well covered, but the repository proof gate expects external PRs to show changed user-visible behavior in a real setup; Matrix live proof requires credentials the contributor says they do not have.

options.title: Require live Matrix proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted Matrix/Element send-read log, terminal transcript, or short recording showing `/reasoning on` as `m.notice` and `/reasoning off` hidden before merge.

options.title: Accept adapter proof after rebase
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly waive live transport proof once the branch uses `reasoningPayloadsEnabled` and the focused tests remain green.

recommendation.title: Require live Matrix proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted Matrix/Element send-read log, terminal transcript, or short recording showing `/reasoning on` as `m.notice` and `/reasoning off` hidden before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He is tied to the current durable-reasoning gate shape that this PR should reuse before any proof waiver is considered.
